recompute_crosscheck.residual_delta_explanation: Small per-block QLIKE deltas (2-10% relative) arise from the 1-hour forecast-window boundary difference (2016 vs 2017 eligible hours) and as-of funding alignment at sparse 8h funding timestamps. They do NOT change the decision, the sign pattern, or the materiality verdict.

decision.rationale: C2 (RV+funding+OI+taker) does NOT achieve a >=2% mean relative QLIKE reduction vs B1 (RV-only HAR) across 3 chronological test blocks (recompute mean rel +1.22%, eval mean rel -1.88%; both fail the -2% materiality floor; only 1/3 blocks improved). Null result preserved as NOT_SUPPORTED per prereg decision gate.
